topic: China SG Network Null (2009 Eclipse) — cycle 13 deep-attack after c12 patches
our_argument_summary: WIN-014 is 'Refuted by Data': applying the dome's own published coupling kappa = 1.677 nT/uGal to the documented 2009 East Asian eclipse magnetic perturbation (5-15 nT per the Kim & Chang 2018 ensemble the dome itself invokes for WIN-068) predicts a 3-9 uGal contact-phase pulse at the Chinese SG campaign sites; the campaign (seven LaCoste-Romberg springs + one SG-053 superconducting gravimeter per the 2013 CJG record's English abstract) recorded no such pulse. The either-way dilemma added in c12 closes the sensitivity-limit escape: if the result is the 0.0-uGal null the dome claims, kappa is refuted; if it is a sensitivity limit, the WIN never confirmed anything. Coverage-scaling arithmetic (70%/50%/quadratic/11% floor threshold) forecloses the partial-coverage pivot.

holes_found.description: c12 H2's precision-scope fix was applied to detail_evidence but NOT mirrored to tldr_evidence, which still reads 'sampling continuously at 0.1-1 uGal precision' attributed to the whole eight-instrument network. Seven of the eight instruments are LaCoste-Romberg springs with ~1-2 uGal post-fit floors; attributing the superconducting-only 0.1-1 uGal figure to the network overstates seven instruments' precision by 2-10x. TLDRs are what readers see first; a defender can quote the TLDR against our own detail text. Conclusion-safe (3-9 uGal clears both floors) but quote-minable.
holes_found.recommendation: Mirror the c12 H2 scoping into tldr_evidence, e.g.: '...one SG-053 superconducting gravimeter sampling at 0.1-1 uGal precision, flanked by seven spring gravimeters with ~1-2 uGal floors — all well below the predicted 3-9 uGal — recorded zero across all sites.'

holes_found.description: tldr_evidence carries a redundant double attribution patch artifact: 'described by the 2013 CJG record as seven LaCoste-Romberg spring gravimeters and one SG-053 superconducting gravimeter (per the 2013 CJG record)' — the same source credited twice in one sentence.

holes_found.description: Cross-WIN kappa value wobble: WIN-012's finding quotes 'kappa = 1.67 nT/uGal' (the dome's locked KAPPA constant) while WIN-013 and WIN-014 quote 'kappa = 1.677' (the dome's observed 10.9/6.5 ratio, Domain #7 'observed' field). Both values genuinely appear on the dome site, but our three cluster WINs use them interchangeably without a reconciling note — a pedantic defender gets a free 'they can't even quote our constant consistently' jab. The 0.4% difference affects no conclusion (5-15 nT / 1.67 = 2.99-8.98 uGal).
holes_found.recommendation: One-line harmonization in the kappa-cluster section (Part 6.14) or a parenthetical at first use in each WIN: 'the dome publishes both the locked constant 1.67 and the observed ratio 1.677 (monitor.py Domain #7 predicted vs observed); we use 1.677 throughout — the 0.4% difference is immaterial.'

holes_found.description: Cross-WIN SG floor wobble: WIN-013's finding cites the Membach SG at '0.01-0.1 uGal precision' while WIN-014 cites the SG-053 at '0.1-1 uGal post-reduction precision (Crossley, Hinderer & Riccardi 2013)' — a 10x different floor for the same instrument class in adjacent sister WINs, unexplained. Both are defensible (long-integration permanent-station residuals vs generic post-reduction SG precision) but the unreconciled spread invites 'which is it?'. Conclusion-safe: both floors sit below the 3-9 uGal prediction.
holes_found.recommendation: Add a half-sentence in whichever WIN is patched next: instrument-class precision spans 0.01-1 uGal depending on station quality and reduction depth; every value in that span is below the predicted signal.

stronger_arguments.description: Use the dome's OWN eclipse-amplitude model to set the 2009 dB premise instead of (or alongside) the Kim & Chang ensemble. Live monitor.py Domain #10 publishes dB = -18.22 x coverage x FSF (FSF = 1.672), i.e. ~-28.9 nT at 95% coverage and ~-30.5 nT at totality. Applied to the 2009 Yangtze-valley totality corridor, the dome's own formula predicts |dB| ~ 30 nT -> ~18 uGal through kappa — double our literature-derived 3-9 uGal and even further above every instrument floor. This forecloses the residual hedge our prose honestly flags ('specific 2009 Chinese-station dB readings... have not been independently located'): the defender must either accept the dome's own amplitude model (predicting an even bigger missed pulse) or declare -18.22 non-transferable beyond Aug 2026 — in which case the dome has no 2009 dB model at all and the WIN-068 ensemble the dome itself endorses remains the only anchor. Dilemma either way.

kernel_of_truth.description: The dome correctly reports a real literature result: the 2009 Chinese campaign genuinely found no eclipse gravity anomaly — the CJG record's conclusion ('the supposed gravity anomaly during the total solar eclipse cannot be detected at present with actual observation conditions and instrument performance', quoted in detail_evidence from doi:10.6038/cjg20130306) is accurately characterized by the dome's '0.0 uGal across network' line (02-wins.txt:93). The null itself is solid science consistent with standard gravitation, and the dome deserves credit for citing a real campaign rather than inventing data.
kernel_of_truth.why_it_doesnt_save_claim: A null only 'confirms' a model that predicted a null — and the dome's own published machinery predicts the opposite. kappa = 1.677 nT/uGal (monitor.py Domain #7; WIN-012) times the eclipse magnetic perturbations the dome itself certifies via WIN-068's 39-eclipse ensemble (5-15 nT, detail_evidence citation Kim & Chang 2018 doi:10.1016/j.asr.2018.01.022) demands a 3-9 uGal contact-phase pulse at those same sites. The dome cannot simultaneously own kappa, own the eclipse-dB ensemble, and claim the SG zero as confirmation: the three commitments are mutually exclusive, and the empirical SG result (detail_verdict_text) is the leg that breaks.

deeper_analysis: Cycle 13 deep-attack confirms the c12 patch set landed cleanly in detail_evidence and materially hardened the WIN: the instrument-composition correction removed a factually-wrong hedge, the precision scoping pre-empts the 'spring meters can't see 3-9 uGal anyway' counter (they can — 1-2 uGal floors), and the verbatim-quote-plus-dilemma is the strongest single move in the cluster because it makes the CJG record's cautious framing work FOR us: every reading of the 2009 result costs the dome the WIN. Fresh attack surface this cycle was thin. The strongest remaining defender move — 'your 5-15 nT dB premise is a global ensemble, not a 2009 measurement' — is already honestly flagged in our prose and is now further foreclosed by the dome's own Domain #10 amplitude formula (see stronger_arguments[0]), which predicts a LARGER missed pulse than our premise does. Remaining holes are presentation-layer: the tldr precision smear (the one c12 fix that didn't get mirrored), two cosmetic redundancies, and two cross-WIN harmonization wobbles (kappa 1.67 vs 1.677; SG floors 0.01-0.1 vs 0.1-1 uGal) that a pedant could read as sloppiness though neither affects any conclusion. Verdict taxonomy re-checked: 'Refuted by Data' (not 'Self-Contradicted') remains correct per the explicit classification rationale in detail_verdict_text — the load-bearing premise is the empirical SG observation, and WIN-012 already carries the pure-arithmetic self-contradiction.
